TerryXuFileSave.description: Save VIDEO / STRING / IMAGE / AUDIO from one input with type-aware controls, internal or external filenames, and an optional sequence suffix.

filename_input.name: Filename
filename_input.tooltip: Connect an external STRING; when connected it overrides the internal filename.

TerryXuVideoCompare.description: A/B synchronized video comparison preview. Drag the center divider to inspect differences; the bottom timeline controls both videos together.

TerryXuGroupManager.description: Manually select workflow groups and independently enable or bypass the nodes inside each group.

TerryXuH3PromptEditor.description: Visual MiniMax H3 prompt editor with dynamic image, video and audio references. Use @ for media and / for H3 syntax commands; output is always standard H3 STRING text.

visual_preview.name: Visual Preview
visual_preview.tooltip: On: visualize tags. Off: show raw H3 text.

TerryXuH3ShotTimeline.description: Timeline mode of TerryXu H3 Prompt Editor with multi-reference assets, tagged shot descriptions, shot ordering and duration editing, plus optional soundscape/music fields.

TerryXuWireBusPack.description: Bundle any number of connections into one virtual bus. Supports KJNodes Get/Set.

TerryXuWireBusUnpack.description: Restore the original connection count, types and order from a virtual bus. Supports KJNodes Get/Set.

TerryXuWirelessBusPack.description: Publish multiple connections to an independent TerryXu wireless bus channel.

TerryXuWirelessBusUnpack.description: Select a TerryXu wireless bus channel and restore all of its connections.
